import pandas as pd

# Rename columns
df.rename(columns={
    "Player's List": 'Player',
    'Base Price': 'Base_Price',
    'COST IN ₹ (CR.)': 'Cost_INR_Cr',
    'Cost IN $ (000)': 'Cost_USD_000',
    '2022 Squad': 'Prev_Team'
}, inplace=True)

# Convert Base_Price to numeric (handles strings safely)
df['Base_Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Base_Price'], errors='coerce')

# Convert cost columns to numeric too (important)
df['Cost_INR_Cr'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Cost_INR_Cr'], errors='coerce')
df['Cost_USD_000'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Cost_USD_000'], errors='coerce')

# Create Sold / Unsold flag
df['Status'] = df['Team'].apply(lambda x: 'Unsold' if x == 'Unsold' else 'Sold')

# Now conversion works safely
df['Base_Price_Cr'] = df['Base_Price'] / 1e7

# Fill missing values
df['Cost_INR_Cr'] = df['Cost_INR_Cr'].fillna(0)
df['Cost_USD_000'] = df['Cost_USD_000'].fillna(0)

# Split datasets
sold_df = df[df['Status'] == 'Sold'].copy()
unsold_df = df[df['Status'] == 'Unsold'].copy()

print(f' Sold Players: {len(sold_df)}')
print(f' Unsold Players: {len(unsold_df)}')

# --- 4.1 Sold vs Unsold Distribution ---
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))

status_counts = df['Status'].value_counts()
axes[0].pie(
    status_counts,
    labels=status_counts.index,
    autopct='%1.1f%%',
    colors=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'],
    startangle=90,
    explode=[0.05, 0.05]
)
axes[0].set_title('Sold vs Unsold Players', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Sold vs Unsold by Player Type
type_status = df.groupby(['TYPE', 'Status']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
type_status.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1], color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], edgecolor='black')
axes[1].set_title('Sold vs Unsold by Player Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Player Type')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sold_vs_unsold.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('Sold vs Unsold counts:')
print(status_counts)

# --- 8.2 Retention rate by team ---

prev_team_losses = sold_with_prev[~sold_with_prev['Retained']]['Prev_Team'].value_counts().head(10)

prev_team_losses.plot(kind='bar', color='tomato', edgecolor='black')
plt.title('Teams That Lost Most Players to Other Teams', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Previous Team')
plt.ylabel('Players Lost')
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('players_lost.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
